acceptanceCriteria: A decision records the chosen public benchmark, its licence and why it measures Corvint's job.
A one-command harness reproduces Corvint's published numbers from pinned inputs on a clean machine without network after fetch.
Published results separate self-run from independently reproduced numbers.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 from a review of vectorize-io/hindsight (MIT agent-memory system; README reviewed via summary, paper arXiv 2512.12818 and code not read). Hindsight's main adoption lever is a public benchmark result (LongMemEval) reproduced by independent groups, plus a live results page with per-configuration accuracy, latency and cost. Corvint's external validation remains open (V1-0014, V1-0019). Candidate: choose an existing public code-context retrieval benchmark (verify which exist and their licences first), ship a one-command local harness with pinned inputs and published results, and invite independent reruns. Corvint self-results stay labelled as self-use, not independent validation.
title: eval: publish a reproducible public retrieval benchmark harness that third parties can rerun
